stem.text: The compounds shown are all produced by plants.
Each compound is warmed with acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$.
Which compound will give a different observation to the other three?

A.alt: Skeletal formula, option A: alcohol with an OH group and a C=C bond in the chain

B.alt: Skeletal formula, option B: alcohol with an OH group and two C=C bonds in the chain

C.alt: Skeletal formula, option C: alcohol with an OH group and two C=C bonds in the chain

D.alt: Skeletal formula, option D: tertiary alcohol with a vinyl group and a C=C bond in the chain
